key_insight: Simulation-driven optimization improved hydrofoil efficiency, with adjoint optimization delivering a reported 15% increase over the conventional design.
engineering_relevance: CFD-based design optimization can replace intuition-led hydrofoil adjustments with systematic exploration of higher-performing geometries.
method: Capture the conventional hydrofoil geometry using structured light scanning and explore five derived designs.
Train a machine-learning surrogate on design-of-experiments simulation data for multi-objective optimization.
Apply adjoint optimization to refine geometries with greater design freedom.
evidence_signal: CFD evaluations indicated gains from both optimization approaches, including a 15% efficiency increase from adjoint refinement of the conventional hydrofoil.
watch_item: Reported gains apply under specific simulated conditions; the abstract does not establish experimental validation or robustness across operating conditions.
paper_title: Improving Hydrofoil Efficiency Through Simulation-Driven Design Optimization
